qa_pairs.question: What should be applied to the wheel house opening and end plate/trunk floor plate area?
qa_pairs.answer: A coat of spot welding paint should be applied on the wheel house opening and end plate/trunk floor plate.

qa_pairs.question: What needs to be done to mating surfaces on a partial replacement section?
qa_pairs.answer: Grind mating surfaces on the partial replacement section.

qa_pairs.question: What type of welding joint should be inserted for the gas weld mating surface?
qa_pairs.answer: Insert gas weld mating surface joint.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done with the partial replacement section after grinding the mating surfaces?
qa_pairs.answer: Clamp on and tack weld the partial replacement section.

qa_pairs.question: What gap should be checked between components?
qa_pairs.answer: Check gap between trunk lid and side panel.

qa_pairs.question: What type of weld should be used for the tail panel and side panel connection?
qa_pairs.answer: Autogen weld web of tail panel and side panel.

qa_pairs.question: Which diagram shows the application of body sealing compound?
qa_pairs.answer: Diagram 30 41 080 shows the application of body sealing compound in the area of fuel tank filler neck.

qa_pairs.question: Which diagram number shows the clamping and tack welding procedure?
qa_pairs.answer: Diagram 30 41 082 shows the clamping and tack welding of the partial replacement section.
